summary: An accessor (getter) method returns a field's value, and a mutator (setter) method changes it. A mutator can check a new value before it saves it.
notes: self._gpa uses a leading underscore to say: use the methods, not the field.
set_gpa only saves new_gpa when it is between 0.0 and 4.0.
maya.get_gpa() needs parentheses to call the method.
pitfall: Writing maya.get_gpa without parentheses prints something like <bound method Student.get_gpa of ...> instead of the GPA.
